kind: historical review at Marcos request; no experiment restarted
scope: Behavioral repairs and transfer in deleted second-round attempts. No acceptance of the intended recurring-overlap method, no new population selection, no sealed outcomes read.
score_definition: All three requested fields (available, required, verdict) correct; explanation quality separate; arithmetic controls excluded.

construction_declaration.status: Locations declared before native input assessment; no checkpoint constructed

selection.meaning: Operational inclusion threshold, not a statistical significance test. Include every layer with at least 1% of a supported erroneous-passage direction difference in any required-climb, comparison, required-summary or final-fields map.

construction_declaration.selection_reason: Start with every selected layer's direct attention-output and feed-forward-output matrix, chosen through actual recorded first-merge connections. These unknowns address each measured local turn simultaneously. Upstream gate/up and attention/cache matrices remain cataloged for expansion if input support cannot express most of the trace target.

target.failure: Question-specific compatible natural-success turn contrast at supported erroneous passages; all original positions retained as supported repair, zero target, or unresolved.
target.population: 18 target failures, 27 natural successes; same-card contrast only

observations.reproduction: Same original natural prompts and card assignments, qualified stream recorder. Every generated token/full score hash and every one of 105 merge turns/norms must match original records. Compact native matrix inputs retained; disposable reproduced stream released per case.

construction_declaration.joint_model: All declared direct projection changes are fitted as one block-structured local inverse, at fixed recorded inputs. This is an explicitly local approximation: nonlinear downstream input and cache effects are measured in the combined native candidate and remeasured between steps, not assumed zero.
construction_declaration.solver_status: Input rank, attainable contrast and conditioning to be measured before frozen numerical fit and application.
construction_declaration.score: Originally failing energy-accounting answers fixed, per field and whole answer. Regressions of other questions secondary and do not gate A2.
construction_declaration.continuation: Measure natural 73 and full-path per-layer gap after each accepted trace step; continue until failures fixed or residual demonstrated unreachable. B2 protection, C2 repair preservation, D2 background shaping follow without new confirmation.
